valid.reviewer-confirmed-same-category.json: Reviewer confirmation matches exact earlier category identity and completed Review.
valid.reviewer-selected-disagrees.json: Reviewer may select a different category without superseding reporter assertion.
valid.reviewer-selected-unable.json: Reviewer may remain unable to determine without invalidating reporter category.
valid.reviewer-confirmed-unable.json: Reviewer confirmation may confirm unable-to-determine semantics.
valid.disagreement-both-active.json: Reporter and reviewer assertions may both remain active; disagreement is not supersession.

application_invalid.confirmed-category-mismatch.json: Reviewer-confirmed category identity must match reviewed Classification.
application_invalid.confirmed-result-branch-mismatch.json: Reviewer-confirmed result branch must match reviewed Classification.
application_invalid.review-ref-does-not-match-supplied-revie: Classification review_ref must resolve to supplied Review.
application_invalid.review-different-event.json: Governing Review must belong to same Event.
application_invalid.selector-does-not-match-reviewer.json: Reviewer-stage selector must match governing Review reviewer.
application_invalid.active-before-review-completed.json: Active reviewer-stage Classification requires completed governing Review.
Reviewed Classification must belong to same Event.
application_invalid.reviewed-classification-ref-does-not-mat: reviewed_classification ref must resolve to supplied predecessor.
application_invalid.review-target-mismatch.json: Reviewer Classification target must align with governing Review target.
